I think I’ve just moved beyond that stage already. I was really, inconsolably upset for about two days after our fight and I have gradually reconciled myself to the inevitable since. Just seeing the date on these papers was a surprise.

The good thing about going through a divorce now is that there is so much chaos and awfulness in the world right now that it is hard to maintain a significant emotional response to anything. Because five minutes later there will be a mew terrible thing to upset you.

Yep! Had a big fight about three weeks ago. She stopped talking to me. Now here we are. We don’t fight. Or didn’t fight. Now I think maybe that was the first sign something was going wrong — it meant we weren’t talking about things that were important. Just pushing them aside.

I don’t know about good coping mechanisms. I definitely spent a while not coping at all. But I’ve had time to think and I recognize this is out of my control. I think we could find a way forward but she does not, and there is no relationship without two parties.

After some time and thought I felt like there was a way forward if we both tried. I reached out to her, but she had sent divorce papers by then. My own role cannot be discounted — I acted badly in ways I didn’t realize until we had this time apart. Things we never talked about.

This may well be the right solution. I’m just shocked all this happened without a word. It took three messages, after I tried to contact her, for it to be clear she wanted a divorce. And she’d already sent the papers. To lean on gaming parlance, it was a slap it the face.
